description:
Our monthly home value index for the eight capital cities, for all dwellings, houses and units: index level (May 2022 = 100) plus 1-month and 12-month change. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: Eight capital cities (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Perth, Hobart, Darwin, Canberra), each for all dwellings, houses and units; monthly, May 2022 to September 2026 (53 months). Greater-capital-city areas; no suburb or regional series. Current to 2026-09-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/home-value-index`.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**
